goal: Allow users and external wallets to manually protect blocks from pruning on pruned nodes
Prevents blocks needed for rescans from being deleted while a wallet is unloaded or offline
agreement: Substantive support for enabling wallet rescans on pruned nodes (achow101, stickies-v)
Concept approval with open questions on startup lock options and minor test cleanups (andrewtoth)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it adds RPCs external wallets need to hold blocks on disk without disabling pruning
Enables wallets to build on pruned nodes without missing blocks during offline periods
